# litellm_secret_backend_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the LiteLLM secrets engine that constrains generated virtual keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "litellm_secret_backend_role" "team_a" {
  backend = litellm_secret_backend.litellm.path
  name    = "team-a"

  models     = ["gpt-4o", "claude-3-5-sonnet"]
  max_budget = 50
  ttl        = 3600
  max_ttl    = 86400

  metadata = {
    team = "a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the LiteLLM secrets engine. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the role. Keys are generated from creds/<name>. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `key_alias_prefix` (String) Prefix for the auto-generated key alias. Defaults to "vault".
- `max_budget` (Number) Spending limit applied to each generated key. 0 means unlimited.
- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for keys generated from this role.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata attached to each generated key.
- `models` (Set of String) Models a generated key may access. Empty means unrestricted.
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for keys generated from this role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/roles/<name>.
terraform import litellm_secret_backend_role.team_a litellm/roles/team-a
```
